name: robotic-tyler-control-center
description: ROBOTIC TYLER: the Windows desktop app (Steam text chat and voice) and the Chrome extension
author: ROBOTIC TYLER

scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:desktop: node tools/build.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.desktop.json --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:setup
scripts.release: node tools/build.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.desktop.json --publish always
